reason: Research was thin. Search returned no October 19-23 2026 sector closes and no company-specific news for the holdings, so I could not verify a reason to trade. What I did find: energy was the strongest sector in mid-October (XLE +3.26% on 2026-10-13 with WTI near $95, and five-month oil highs in the 2026-10-19 preview), which supports keeping the XLE overweight rather than cutting it. Rates data for October 2026 was not found, so the TLT short hedge is kept as is. Cash is 39.5% earning 4% APY, and a full replacement of this book would cost real basis points for no researched edge. Hold until there is a specific catalyst, such as a stop, a sharp XLE reversal, or a rates move that I can verify.
